answers.core: to achieve the expected darkening in crevaces of models, we need a way to darken metallic surfaces at glacing angles. currently there is no way to affect this.
answers.workaround:
1- the specular can be easily affected by Ambient Occlusion in a shaderMaterial by multiplying it with the ao map.
2- but for metallic materials this does not work, even when setting all inputs to dark in a shaderMaterial, a glossy metallic surface will still result in a bright rimlight in the end.

title: Change the way BaseMaterial3D handles Ambient Occlusion
